summary: Assist to Summit County with two rescue techs for a stranded hiker on Quandary Peak
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Summit County SAR
notes: ART mission 2024-145. | Advnture narrative (opened): Saturday-evening cell-phone call from a solo hiker cliffed out near the summit on the West Ridge (Class 3) of Quandary Peak; helo established contact but terrain too risky in the dark — all teams spent the night at 14,000 ft while a mental-health clinician coached him by phone; hoisted out at sunrise.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Quandary Peak)
